orders: Bilateral visual-acuity testing with corrective lenses and pinhole testing
Pupillary examination, including direct and consensual light responses and assessment for a relative afferent pupillary defect
Extraocular-movement examination and assessment for diplopia
External ocular examination, including eyelids, periorbital tissues, and ocular alignment
Slit-lamp examination of the anterior segment
Intraocular-pressure measurement by tonometry, if globe rupture is not suspected

order_raw:
1. Bilateral visual-acuity testing with corrective lenses and pinhole testing
2. Pupillary examination, including direct and consensual light responses and assessment for a relative afferent pupillary defect
3. Confrontation visual-field testing
4. Extraocular-movement examination and assessment for diplopia
5. External ocular examination, including eyelids, periorbital tissues, and ocular alignment
6. Slit-lamp examination of the anterior segment
7. Fluorescein staining with cobalt-blue illumination
8. Intraocular-pressure measurement by tonometry, if globe rupture is not suspected
9. Dilated fundoscopic examination
10. Noncontrast CT of the orbits and facial bones
11. B-scan ocular ultrasonography, if the globe is intact but the posterior segment cannot be adequately visualized

dx: Traumatic right internuclear ophthalmoplegia due to injury of the right medial longitudinal fasciculus
